scope: Public-source audit only. No image rendering, final-RGB ablations, coefficient fitting, author contact, new transport integration, or baseline changes.

external_acceptance_constraint.meaning: Opposite local spatial trends survive the existing translation sensitivity check; not a measured pure halation PSF. Exact radii and differences remain registration-limited; middle lamp lacks inner ceiling support.

decision: Freeze material/source/scanner attribution and candidate development until new independently identifying measurements are acquired. No newly verified measurement in this bounded audit unfreezes the hypotheses.
network_limit: Google/Bing, Drive, GitHub API, manufacturer and data-portal entries were blocked before origin HTTP. GitHub web/raw succeeded. Not an exhaustive worldwide absence claim; private author holdings unknown.
